# TfL Piccadilly Line audio

The Piccadilly Line PIS is created by KeTech and uses a proprietary format that is not publicly documented.

## Deocding the audio

This is all guesswork.

### Entries

Audio and PIS entries can be found from offset `0041B200` onwards.

Each entry consists of, what I assume is, a PIS message, as well as a list of audio offsets.

**Example entry:**

```
0B 00 00 00 00 00 00 41 11 53 79 73 74 65 6D 20 53 6F 75 6E 64 20 54 65 73 74 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 45 03 06 00 00 00 00 00 00 06 43 00 0B 31 00 01 30 33 38 35 00 0E 41 30 30 34 31 42 32 30 30 00 0D 0A 30 30 30 30 30 30 33 44 00 0D 0A 30 30 30 30 30 30 33 44 00 0D 0A 30 30 30 30 30 30 33 44 00 0D 0A 30 30 30 30 30 30 33 44 00 0D 0A 30 30 30 30 30 30 33 44 00 0D 0A 30 30 30 30 30 30 33 44 00 0D 0A 30 30 30 30 30 30 33 44 00 0D 0A 30 30 30 30 30 30 33 44 00 0D 0A 30 30 30 30 30 30 33 44 00 0D 0A 30 30 30 30 30 30 33 44 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 D7 58
```

Each entry begins with `0B`, followed by six null bytes.

Then is the PIS message in ASCII.

Then is a list of audio offsets (I think).
